# TNF Week 9 - Jaguars at Ravens, Thu Nov 5, 8:15 PM

Lines: Jaguars -10 (opened -8.5/-9.5, peaked -10.5; 83-86% of spread money on JAX), ML JAX ~-520, total 39.5-40 (opened 42.5).
Ravens QB: Lamar Jackson (thumb) on IR, Tyler Huntley (toe) out/doubtful - undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano (ankle) starts.
Models: WagerTalk projects JAX 23-16 (Ravens +10 covers); Dimers JAX 81% (~9.5, on the number); SportsLine total 48 (Over 40 at 60%), side hidden.
Prediction: Jaguars 24, Ravens 14.
No bet. Side: fading a third-string QB is our winning angle (Bengals vs Ravens backup, 35-13), but no model has Jacksonville winning by 10+, and the line already moved 1.5 points on 85% of the money. Total: SportsLine 48 vs WagerTalk 39 - split. Lean Jaguars only at -9.5 or better.
